==Notes==
* After reaching the first [[allegiance rank]], Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, [[level]] 20 [[character]]s may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The [[skill icon]] for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*Combines well with [[Asuran Scan]] on [[martial]] classes.
